10k.note: 10-K describes Globus Medical as a musculoskeletal medical device company designing/marketing spine implants, robotic-guidance and imaging systems, and orthopedic trauma/extremity products (post-NuVasive era). Product portfolio is FDA-cleared / 510(k) commercial devices; no investigational drug pipeline disclosed.

website.error: no public drug-pipeline page — Globus Medical is a commercial medical-device company; corporate site lists marketed product lines (spine, robotics, trauma, extremities), not P1/P2/P3 drug or device clinical trials.

ctgov.note: No interventional P1/P2/P3 trials returned with Globus Medical as lead sponsor. Post-market clinical follow-up of approved devices is out of scope of P1/P2/P3 active pipeline.

commercial_product.note: Globus Medical's revenue derives entirely from FDA-cleared / approved commercial medical devices; no proprietary clinical-stage drug or device under IND/IDE pivotal study disclosed.
marketed_franchises: Spine implants and biologics (cervical, thoracolumbar, MIS, expandable interbody)
Enabling technologies / robotics (ExcelsiusGPS surgical robot, Excelsius3D imaging)
Orthopedic trauma, extremities, and joint reconstruction (post-NuVasive integration)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medtech / device company — no proprietary drug pipeline. Globus Medical develops and markets FDA-cleared spine, orthopedic, and surgical-robotics devices; it does not operate a P1/P2/P3 drug-development pipeline, and ClinicalTrials.gov shows no active interventional pivotal/IDE study with Globus as lead sponsor.
